name: zreader_load_node_from_path
description: zReader::LoadNodeFromPath strips incoming paths to a basename, opens the member from mounted ZRDR archives, reads the node tree, and returns null when no mounted archive supplies the member.
known_limits: tier S verification remains pending for the broader ZRDR archive/load cluster. The fixture smoke exercises basename stripping and archive-backed node loading; the retail ZRDR smoke parses known .zrd members from support/zbd/zrdr.zbd and support/zbd/m1/zrdr.zbd.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 byte verification for covered address 0x48d1c0 through the zreader_load_node_from_path target passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 28 relocation-masked bytes and 5 trimmed VC NOPs.
VC5SP3 byte verification for covered address 0x48cda0 through the zreader_load_node_from_path target passed with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 4 relocation-masked bytes and 8 trimmed VC NOPs.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x48cda0 validates the fastcall ABI with ECX as headerWord and EDX as fieldCount, allocation of fieldCount 8-byte zReader_Node records through malloc, storing headerWord in result->type, and returning the allocated node without a null guard.

Binary Ninja assembly for 0x48d1c0 validates null mounted-list handling, iterating mounted archives by zArchiveList::GetCount/GetAt, calling zIndexArchive::OpenFileByName(path, 0), returning the first non-INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE handle, and returning INVALID_HANDLE_VALUE when no archive supplies the member.

The native archive-loading smoke mounts an index archive, verifies the direct OpenFileByName path, and then loads the archived ZRDR node through zReader::LoadNodeFromPath using the mounted archive list.
